name: store-keeps-contents-that-do-not-hash
breaks: a node refuses contents that do not hash to the paid hash

edits.from: if (!event.verifyHash().valid) return 'contents do not hash to the paid hash';
edits.to: if (false && !event.verifyHash().valid) return 'contents do not hash to the paid hash';

red: refuses contents that do not hash to their hash, and takes the message whole from an honest peer
keeps every message the chain paid for, as its owner signed it, at its own record

name: decider-applies-an-unauthorized-update
breaks: a node's decider refuses an update its app's owner did not sign
red: refuses a forged signature and a former owner's update
holds the newest valid message of every app
